title: iPhone Duo ön sipariş tarihleri ve üretim süreci açıklandı
summary: Apple'ın katlanabilir telefonu iPhone Duo için ön sipariş süreci 16 Ekim'de başlıyor. Cihazın üretiminde ise kalite standartları nedeniyle zorluklar yaşanıyor.
body:
9to5Mac ve Tom's Guide sitelerinin aktardığına göre, Apple'ın ilk katlanabilir telefonu **iPhone Duo** için ön sipariş dönemi 16 Ekim'de saat 08.00 ET / 05.00 PT itibarıyla resmi olarak hayata geçiyor. Şirketin web sitesindeki güncellemeye göre, kullanıcılar cihazı hızlı bir şekilde satın alabilmek için hazırlık sürecine 12 Ekim Pazartesi gününden itibaren başlayabilecek.

## Ön sipariş hazırlığı ve detaylar

Apple Store uygulaması veya şirketin internet sitesi üzerinden yürütülecek hazırlık aşamasında kullanıcılar renk, depolama alanı, kablosuz operatör ve ödeme yöntemi gibi seçimlerini önceden yapabilecek. 12 Ekim ile 15 Ekim günleri arasında gerçekleştirilebilecek bu ön hazırlık, 16 Ekim'deki asıl ön sipariş yoğunluğunda ödeme adımının daha hızlı tamamlanmasını ve teslimat şansının artmasını sağlıyor.

## Üretim süreci ve üretim adetleri

Tom's Guide'ın Jiemian News kaynaklı haberine göre, üretim ortağı Foxconn'daki üretim hattında verimlilik oranı katlanabilir ekran ve menteşe bileşenlerindeki zorluklar nedeniyle yüzde 60 seviyesinde bulunuyor. Apple'ın kalite standartlarından ödün vermemesi nedeniyle küresel pazar için ilk etapta 6 ila 8 milyon arasında cihaz üretilmesi bekleniyor. **1.999 dolar** başlangıç fiyatıyla satışa çıkacak olan katlanabilir telefonun küresel pazardaki ilk stoklarının sınırlı kalacağı tahmin ediliyor.

**Neden önemli?** Apple'ın ilk katlanabilir telefon modeli olan iPhone Duo, yüksek fiyatı ve katlanabilir pazarındaki rekabetin yanı sıra katı üretim standartları nedeniyle teknoloji dünyasında yakından takip ediliyor.

source_texts.title: Apple announces when you can start the iPhone Duo pre-order process
source_texts.summary: iPhone Duo pre-orders start on Friday, October 16, but Apple just announced when you can get an early start on the process. Here are the details. more…
source_texts.text:
iPhone Duo pre-orders start on Friday, October 16, but Apple just announced when you can get an early start on the process. Here are the details.
Apple will let you ‘Get ready’ for iPhone Duo pre-orders beginning October 12 for fastest checkout
When Apple launches a major new iPhone model, it usually offers a window of time during which you can ‘Get ready’ for the pre-order by making your selections in advance.
The company just confirmed it will do the same for iPhone Duo. Per a new update on Apple’s website, you can begin the iPhone Duo pre-order process as early as Monday, October 12.
Starting October 12, and likely running through much of the day October 15, you’ll be able to go to the Apple Store app or Apple’s online store and make your pre-order selections in advance.
This includes choosing your iPhone Duo color, storage amount, wireless carrier, payment method, and more.
By completing this process ahead of time, Apple says you can get through checkout faster when iPhone Duo pre-orders go live on Friday, October 16 at 8:00 a.m. ET / 5:00 a.m. PT.
If you haven’t done it before, I highly recommend the ‘Get ready’ process to anyone ordering directly from Apple. It’s a great way to minimize potential hiccups on the morning of pre-orders, which means you’ll have a better chance of launch day delivery.
Are you buying an iPhone Duo? Why or why not? Let us know in the comments.

source_texts.text:
A new report from the Chinese publication Jiemian News revealed both bad news and good news about iPhone Duo production.
According to the article, Apple has not completed the expected mass production ramp-up for the company's first foldable phone. Foxconn, Apple's manufacturing partner, has only managed a yield rate of 60%, even with a small production run.
The yield percentage refers to the number of viable devices created during a manufacturing run. At 60%, that means 40% of the produced devices have some flaw that would prevent Apple from selling them.
Even before the announcement earlier this month, it was rumored that Apple was having production issues and that it would only be available in "extremely limited stock." Largely, this is based on the complicated manufacturing process for the foldable phone.
Exacting standards
Here's the caveated good news: per Jiemian, the low yield is thanks to Apple's quality standards, which the company refuses to relax.
"The supply chain is now waiting for Apple to make a decision on whether to relax the quality requirements," an unnamed source who is allegedly close to the Foxconn supply chain told the outlet (machine translated). "If the quality requirements are relaxed, it will be possible to move towards mass production more quickly."
The source reported that the production line is still debugging the process and repeatedly adjusting things during actual production to optimize equipment and processes.

Reportedly, delays in receiving Samsung Display's OLED panels and some hinge-components have also contributed to delays and lower yields.
Manufacturing isn't expecting to reach maturity for at least another six months.
Apple is only expected to produce around 6 to 8 million iPhone Duo units for its global inventory, a third of what the company will make for the more mature iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, which should get between 20 and 30 million.
Expectations and price
If Apple is able to sell out an initial inventory of 8 million Duos, that would be a major win for the company.
We're still two weeks out from the launch date of October 16, and you can preorder now if you're interested.
With a starting price of $1,999, Apple's take on the foldable is more expensive than the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, but it's nice to know that Apple's high standards means you should get a quality, working device if you buy one.
Apple is causing quite the stir with the Duo but, it'll be interesting to see if customers respond. As we found in a recent reader poll, most of you are more interested in the Z Fold 8 which has seen a surge in popularity since Apple's announcement.
